evidence.reason: `change_undone` compares file-wide sets of added/removed line text. The patch parser at lines 956-959 records only `line[1:]` and discards hunk/location information, so an identical line text changed elsewhere in the same file can falsely intersect with the published repair's added/removed line. That can make `merge_head_evidence` treat an intact repair as undone and reject the merged head. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the existing intended behavior, not a request for expanded scope.
